_README: Measured residuals between what landsat_lst.profiling predicts and what a real
run did. Required by issue #77 item 3: every prediction the model emits gets
checked against at least one real run, and the residual is recorded in the
repository alongside the VM type it was measured on.
This file is data, not prose, so a tile run updates it instead of restarting
the argument. Append a record; do not rewrite history. Records are matched on
vm_type and threads, because neither constant transfers across them.
peak_residuals[].ratio is measured_peak_gib / predicted_floor_gib. The floor is
a lower bound by construction, so the ratio is >= 1 and is what turns a floor
throughput[].tasks_per_second converts a static fused task count into wall
time. Count tasks with `landsat-lst plan`, divide, and the answer is minutes

peak_residuals.source: heartbeat peak_rss_mb, run still in flight at 49.8 percent
peak_residuals.note: Peak had plateaued and held. Issue #77 records 87 GiB for the same run; 78.6 is the value read from the heartbeat at the time and is the conservative one of the two.
Synthetic geometry at 4096x4096. Peak runs 1.3x the floor here against a far wider gap on the real tile, which is the open discrepancy.

throughput.source: run 2021-2025-sample300-20260813T123249Z, observed 237 to 763 per second, averaging roughly 350
throughput.note: Fused tasks per second. Recorded per phase as well as per VM and thread count: the composite retires a different mix of work, so this rate says nothing about it. Does not transfer to another instance type or thread count unexamined.
